title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Jan 2027 data)
source: EST: ISM publishes the Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 ET on the first business day of the month — the derivation this calendar's four existing entries already carry (ism-manufacturing-2026-10-01, -2026-11-02, -2026-12-01, all EST: on that rule, seeded from the confirmed 2026-09-01 entry whose ISM: source was a live ROB-calendar fetch). February 2027's first business day is Monday 2027-02-01: the day is not a US federal holiday (New Year's Day 2027-01-01, then Washington's Birthday 2027-02-15, which this calendar already tracks as presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15), and the NYSE trades a normal session. ismworld.org was re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 and returned a 922-byte Google-reCAPTCHA challenge page rather than the ROB calendar (the same wall the 2026-09-02 attempt hit as a 302 to ecommerce.ismworld.org/SSO/Login.aspx), so no 2027 schedule could be read and this is a rule-derived date and nothing more, checked 2026-09-05
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-02-01 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and it is the whole attribution point of that ledger. The BoJ Summary of Opinions for the Jan 21-22, 2027 MPM publishes 08:50 JST Mon 2027-02-01 = 18:50 EST Sun 2027-01-31, i.e. the evening BEFORE this US session; the US cash session that a reader would be tempted to credit to the BoJ actually carries a US manufacturing PMI at 10:00 ET, three sessions after fomc-2027-01-27 (Chair Warsh's first meeting and the FOMC's annual organizational meeting). Measured in that ledger across all 86 Summaries of Opinions the BoJ has ever published, the SoO's own US-session footprint is indistinguishable from an ordinary day (63% of SoO sessions inside the 0.736% baseline against 64% of all sessions), so on 2027-02-01 the ISM print is the higher-prior explanation of any US move by a wide margin. Filed at impact high to match the four sibling ISM manufacturing entries, whose reasoning stands unchanged: prices-paid and new-orders reprice the Fed-cut path and 10Y real yields, i.e. the discount rate on long-duration tech, which is the only channel from this corridor that reaches this calendar's AI names at all. The corridor around 2027-02-01 previously held only three tracked items (fomc-2027-01-27, japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-01-29 and the Summary itself) and no US data print whatsoever, despite the calendar tracking ISM manufacturing monthly through 2026-12-01 — a coverage gap that ends at the 2026 year boundary rather than at any analytical judgement. The January 2027 employment situation report would also fall inside this corridor (2027-02-05 by the usual first-Friday convention) and is deliberately NOT proposed: this calendar's jobs entries all carry a live BLS: source and bls.gov returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-05, so proposing it would mean inventing a date the primary could not confirm.
